title: Jacobi symbol of two modulo an odd integer
statement: Let $N$ be a finite bit string whose represented integer is odd. The Jacobi symbol $(2/N)$ is $-1$ if the bits in positions two and three of $N$ differ, and $1$ if they agree; a missing bit is taken to be $0$.
hypotheses_covered: The integer represented by $N$ is odd
